asset.name: BeforeAfterSlider
asset.description: The direct-comparison surface with pointer, touch, and keyboard control, selectable orientation, labels, reset, and alignment that holds as the container resizes.

requires.reason: Pointer capture, constraints, and velocity keep movement outside React rendering.
Layout is reserved before media resolves so nothing shifts on load.
Both images load through the shared component.

signatureMoment.description: The divider tracks the pointer exactly and both images stay pinned to their own edges, so the comparison never drifts out of alignment while being explored.
